title: The Waking
hook: The previous keeper's notes contradict the site evidence. Either they misread the sequence or we have. One of us has set something in motion that the other cannot correct.

title: The Canopy
hook: They set off. The Valharian system was their heading. It was a quick 2 week journey. Löm looked back at their home Vivendë, with a feeling in his heart that he may never see it again. He placed his hand on the window as he stared down at the blue-green marble disappearing from his sight.

title: The Severance of Galendieer
hook: Something is growing these places, like a forbidden garden. Feeding the plants, cultivating something truly amazing. Enticing the people of that sector to return home. That's when it happens. The Severance.

title: The Release
hook: There's a fog. Always a fog. Dense and swirling, writhing with unholy purpose. Through the fog there are flowers. It loves flora. Dense thickets of trees, fields of flowers, unnaturally tall and wild forests. It seems obsessed. Each site has had something beautiful, something irresistible. I've been researching the signs, the artifacts that are the tell. When I arrive at a site, I take it all in very slowly, with methodology.
